svg.aria-label: Apple M1 Firestorm core, the whole machine as we think it is
svg.text: Apple M1 Firestorm core, the whole machine as we think it is
Every structure is drawn as what it is. Numbers are capacities, and pills on arrows are widths per clock. Arrow weight is traffic kind. A queue size a | b is Handley's count, then what probes see.
shared by the cluster or the chip
+ Each op steers to the queue with the most room.
store and load share base reg
L1D, 16 x 16 B or 128 x 2 B
128 KiB, 8 way, 64 B, 3 clk, 4 to ALU,
L2 rates each core every 32 clk
4 cores with their own L2 and AMX
8 x 8 PEs, 4 reg sets, 1 per cluster
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
